_comment: PLACEHOLDER hashes below. Do not deploy this as-is — replace this whole file with a real ComfyUI-Manager 'Save Snapshot' export from the shared Comfy instance that currently renders BEXevo/workflows/*.json correctly. See README.md.
_notes: ControlNetLoader / ControlNetApplyAdvanced / ImageScaleToTotalPixels / ImageToMask / SetLatentNoiseMask / KSampler(Advanced) / VAEEncode / VAEDecode / CheckpointLoaderSimple / CLIPTextEncode / UNETLoader / CLIPLoader / VAELoader / LoadImage / SaveImage are core ComfyUI nodes — no extra repo needed, just a comfyui core hash recent enough to have them.

TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus / ModelSamplingAuraFlow / CFGNorm (Qwen-Image support) and Wan22ImageToVideoLatent / Wan22FunControlToVideo / ModelSamplingSD3 (Wan 2.1/2.2 support) are also core, not custom nodes — but they only exist in reasonably recent ComfyUI core builds, so the pinned 'comfyui' hash must postdate their introduction. Confirm by checking the working shared instance's ComfyUI version, don't assume.

LoadVideo / SaveVideo / CreateVideo / GetVideoComponents (used in both Wan video workflows) are also core built-in nodes (docs.comfy.org/built-in-nodes/SaveVideo) as of mid/late-2025 ComfyUI releases — not the older ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite custom node pack. Same caveat: needs a recent enough comfyui hash.
